firmware_metadata.container_format: Apple Image4 Payload (IM4P) wrapping RTKit FTAB

partitions.description: Direct Operating Wireless Power Receiver (RX) Controller
features: Rectifier efficiency tracking & synchronous FET rectification
Foreign Object Detection (FOD) through Q-factor resonance monitoring
Dynamic thermal derating via NTC thermistor telemetry

partitions.description: Direct Operating Wireless Power Transmitter (TX) Controller
features: Reverse wireless power transfer for MagSafe accessories / AirPods
Inverter H-bridge frequency modulation (110 kHz - 205 kHz)
Packet decoding for Qi backscatter communication (ASK modulation)
